categories.main_business_segments: Kengic Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent logistics, intelligent manufacturing, and new energy sectors. The company provides integrated solutions including intelligent logistics systems (conveying and sorting), intelligent manufacturing systems (warehousing and factory automation), and core equipment and software products. It serves both domestic and international markets with a focus on key industries such as express delivery, e-commerce, lithium battery manufacturing, tire manufacturing, and automotive parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including adaptive control for high-speed automated sorting, conveyor system information tracking, 3D dense storage and picking integration, Docker-based microservices for software deployment, multi-axis synchronous motion control, deep learning for defect detection, and neural network-based multi-agent control. Production methods emphasize modular, standardized, and parameterized design for hardware, combined with proprietary software platforms like WMS, WCS, SDS, MES, and intelligent scheduling systems. The company also focuses on energy-saving technologies and predictive maintenance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kengic serves major customers in express logistics (e.g., SF Express, Deppon), e-commerce platforms (e.g., JD.com, Shopee, Coupang, Flipkart, Trendyol), tire manufacturers (e.g., Sailun, Haohua, Senqilin), home appliance and furniture brands (e.g., Haier, Sichuan Changhong, Kuka Home), automotive and industrial enterprises (e.g., CRRC, Weichai Power, Desay SV), and new energy companies (e.g., EVE Energy, Envision Energy, Penghui Energy). The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and overseas markets including Korea, India, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and projects in South Korea, Hong Kong, India, Thailand, Vietnam, Turkey, Czech Republic, Israel, Germany, France, and the Netherlands. Overseas business accounts for over 50% of new orders, with significant growth in international markets driven by local customer development and following domestic strategic clients abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kengic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems and equipment. It designs, develops, manufactures, and installs automation equipment and software solutions that serve upstream manufacturers and downstream logistics and distribution centers. The company also manages supply chain efficiency and resilience by collaborating with upstream core technology suppliers and optimizing procurement and logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in new industry solutions, core foundational technologies, and product innovation, especially in aerial shuttle vehicles, new warehousing and distribution solutions, visual algorithms, intelligent driving, scheduling algorithms, and digital simulation. It pursues internationalization, modularization, digitalization, and standardization strategies. Key R&D projects include multi-layer shuttle cars, high-speed miniload warehouses, automated sorting and picking systems, and new energy battery logistics lines. The company emphasizes building a strong technical team and protecting intellectual property.
categories.revenue_model: Kengic generates revenue primarily through the sale of intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems, core equipment, and software solutions. Revenue is recognized upon project acceptance after installation and commissioning. The company also earns income from after-sales paid services and spare parts sales. It engages in contract-based system integration projects with milestone payments and provides consulting and technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kengic is positioned as a leading domestic provider of intelligent logistics and manufacturing solutions in China, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a provincial champion in manufacturing services. It competes with both international giants like Daifuku, Vanderlande, and Dematic in high-end markets and domestic peers such as Beizi Technology, Kun Chuan Intelligent, and Today International. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive coverage of logistics, warehousing, and factory automation, strong R&D capabilities, and expanding global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kengic achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, representing a 21.35% year-over-year increase. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -58.63 million, the loss narrowed compared to previous years. Total assets grew by 10.3% to RMB 2.91 billion, while net assets decreased by 14.46% due to share repurchases. The company increased R&D spending by 33.14% to RMB 97.35 million, reflecting a growth-oriented investment strategy. Overseas orders and revenues showed strong growth, with overseas new orders increasing by 81.18% and overseas revenue by 150.55%. The company maintains a stable workforce of 986 employees, with 45.23% in R&D roles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kengic emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing end-to-end, fully integrated intelligent logistics and manufacturing solutions that cover the entire industrial and distribution chain. Its products feature advanced automation, digitalization, and intelligent control technologies that improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and flexibility while reducing labor intensity and costs. The company’s modular and customizable product design, combined with strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive after-sales services, enables it to meet diverse customer needs across multiple industries and geographies. Its commitment to innovation, quality, and internationalization further differentiates it in a competitive market.
